caption: Two shades of hair dye are squeezed into a bowl and whisked together, and the mixture becomes one uniform colour.

sa.check: Two shades of hair dye are squeezed into a bowl.
The mixture becomes one uniform colour.
The two shades are visibly different before whisking.
The whisking comes first and the uniform colour follows.

pc.expect: The single blended colour spreads from the whisk through the dye stroke by stroke until the bowl is even and never gathers back; coloured areas stay coloured.
pc.fail: The dye returns to its original colour where it was single blended colour; or the single blended colour gathers back into the whisk; or the single blended colour appears before the whisk arrives.

pc.expect: The result is single blended colour, and un-reached dye keeps its original colour.
pc.fail: The dye turns a colour other than single blended colour; or the un-reached dye changes; or the single blended colour is darker than the whisk itself.

pc.expect: The dye behaves as it should: streaks and swirls where stirred or spread, settling where it flows.
pc.fail: The dye is rigid and unmarked; or it flows like water when it is a paste; or it bounces like rubber.

pc.expect: The dye moves only where stirred or where the single blended colour flows.
pc.fail: The dye swirls by itself; or the single blended colour spreads faster than stirring or flow carries it; or the container moves.

pc.expect: The amount of dye stays the same and the container keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The container fills or empties on its own; or a second container appears; or the whisk passes through the container.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The container and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The container changes colour; or the background rearranges; or the tool changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
